old_problem: The source requires an AC-reboot OS-ping test, but the same-row DeepSeek command removes the AC token; WAT token semantics, AC fixture behavior and the per-cycle reachability oracle are not authoritative.
disposition_reason: ED-03 allows standard scaffolding but forbids guessed OEM parameters; ED-06 and ED-18 require the exact AC transition and complete OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready proof. The conflicting proprietary scenario cannot be parameterized without choosing unsafe command semantics.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row83 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3107 and actual next row84/history3108 were read.
The source command contains both AC and DC tokens while the proposed review-layer command omits AC; no approved WAT document proves equivalence or ordering.
OS ping requires an approved source/target/cadence/timeout/readiness oracle and cannot establish the physical AC transition by itself.
No cycle, power action or DUT command ran; the 250-cycle AC coverage remains intact and blocked.

test_case.test_name: NVIDIA WAT 250 AC reboot cycles with per-cycle OS ping
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved physical AC reboot transition and OS reachability after every one of 250 WAT cycles without changing the source stimulus.
required_package: Owner-approved WAT version/checksum and corrected AC/OS-ping scenario tokens
Rated AC fixture/feed mapping, off/on/discharge dwell and automatic power-on behavior
Secure BMC and OS endpoints plus ping source/target/cadence/timeout/readiness oracle
Per-cycle expected-event, abort, OOB and recovery contract
test_case.test_command: Do not execute. After the owner publishes the authoritative WAT AC/OS-ping scenario, run that exact signed command for 250 cycles on a dedicated SUT; record AC OFF, dwell, ON, BMC/OS readiness and ping result for every cycle.
test_case.expected_result: Each of 250 approved AC cycles proves the full power transition and reaches the defined OS-ready/ping state within approved limits, with no disallowed event or silent retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is unavailable until the scenario contract is approved. After approval, PASS requires all 250 per-cycle power/readiness/ping records; DC or warm reboot, final-only ping, fewer cycles or retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT, rated AC controller and explicit user authorization
Secure secrets and verified OOB access
Preserve pre/post and failed-cycle logs; abort on reachability, boot-loop, power or thermal fault
No automatic retry or substitution of DC/warm reboot
expected_evidence: SEL, host logs, timeouts and abort record
test_case.recovery: Fail fast and preserve the failing cycle. Stop the AC controller safely, restore nominal power and services through the approved OOB procedure, collect final health, and do not retry automatically.
